snippet.title: Boxguy Adventure 3: Super Boxguy World (Early ver Footage)
snippet.description:
Boxguy is now in dinosaur land! Man... why does Boxguy always gets transported to the wrong world every time he defeats a world's villain when the hero of that world is M.I.A. Anyhow story aside this Super Mario World Rom Hack should release this weekend or early next weekend.
